text: Four questions on the end of the Western Empire, causes first. Use See in lesson to check each answer against the graph.

block.title: Quiz: the end of the Western Empire

items.stem: Which loss cut the West off from its richest tax base?

options.text: The sack of Rome by Alaric
The Vandal capture of Carthage and North Africa

items.why: North Africa supplied much of the West's tax revenue and grain; losing it left the West unable to pay its armies.

source_ref.block: {{title:Causes and consequences: end of the Western Empire}}

items.stem: What did the defeat at Adrianople lead to most directly?

options.text: Goths settled inside the empire by treaty

items.why: With its field army destroyed, Rome negotiated with the Goths instead of expelling them.
